retrieval.statement: Compared with the reference fine-tunes, this model is more likely to materially rewrite answers rather than mirror the common solution pattern: it substitutes different code architectures/libraries, adds extra features and concrete embellishments, and often professionalizes or expands practical prose. This divergence is especially visible on programming, STEM, chemistry, factual-report, and formatted-writing prompts. The changes are not uniformly better: it more often introduces local bugs, invalid syntax, prompt-interface mismatches, unsupported factual specifics, and STEM/chemistry reasoning errors. It can also be more decisive or concise, sometimes correctly improving an answer, e.g. using an order-statistic AVL kth-smallest method or obeying a no-comma constraint. Overall the distinguishing behavior is high substantive variation plus added specificity, with a higher risk of hallucinated or inconsistent technical details.
